evidence.ACL: The contour of ACL & PCL appear to be within normal, no abnormal signal intensity is noted.
evidence.MCL: Both medial & lateral collateral ligaments appear to be within normal.
evidence.Medial Meniscus: There are linear signal intensity in posterior horn of medial meniscus, it extends into the surface and blunting of meniscus root, in favor of tear
evidence.Lateral Meniscus: Linear signal intensity in lateral meniscus and anterior horn of medial meniscus, without significant extending into the surface
evidence.Medial OA: mild subchondral edema over posterior apsect of medial femoral condyle and wearing of adjacent articular cartilage.
evidence.Synovitis: hypertrophy of the synovium, indicative of synovitis.
evidence.Baker's: in favor of Baker's cyst with mild perifocal edema and internal sepctum, more than 7 cm in length.
evidence.Contusion: mild subchondral edema over posterior apsect of medial femoral condyle and wearing of adjacent articular cartilage.
